subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish `withSessionTranscriptIndexedWriteLock` and its three mirror-oriented persistence reads as a permanent Plugin SDK contract?
rationale: This is a documented, generated-baseline-pinned public API addition; maintainers must choose its long-term external compatibility boundary rather than treating it as an internal performance refactor.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
options.body: Accept this as a supported SDK primitive after current-head compatibility and real-behavior proof are refreshed.

options.title: Keep the facts owner-internal
options.body: Refactor the indexed reads behind the transcript owner or another non-public seam to avoid expanding the external Plugin SDK contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK contract
recommendation.body: Accept this as a supported SDK primitive after current-head compatibility and real-behavior proof are refreshed.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged and current PR history makes this contributor the clearest available routing candidate for the transcript ownership discussion.
